converters.name: apache2timesketch
converters.description: Apache HTTP Server access (combined/common, other_vhosts) and error logs (2.4 and 2.2 formats) to Timesketch timeline.

converters.name: browser2timesketch
converters.description: Browser history (Firefox/Chrome/Chromium/Edge SQLite databases) to Timesketch timeline.

converters.name: cloudtrail2timesketch
converters.description: AWS CloudTrail JSON/JSON.gz exports to Timesketch timeline.

converters.name: cloudtrail2vestigo
converters.description: AWS CloudTrail JSON/JSON.gz exports (file or directory) to a Vestigo Parquet file for direct upload. Requires pyarrow.

converters.name: conntrackd2timesketch
converters.description: conntrackd flow logs (conntrackd-stats.log, plain or .gz) to Timesketch timeline, with both connection tuples as discrete columns and the address translation between them derived into nat_type/translated_src_ip/translated_dst_ip.

converters.name: cowrie2timesketch
converters.description: Cowrie SSH/Telnet honeypot JSON logs (plain, rotated, or gzip) to Timesketch timeline.

converters.name: evtx2timesketch
converters.description: Windows Event Log text exports (wevtutil XML, evtx_dump XML/JSONL) to Timesketch timeline.

converters.name: evtx2vestigo
converters.description: Binary Windows Event Log (.evtx) files (file or directory) to a Vestigo Parquet file for direct upload, with EvtxECmd map-based event descriptions and Sigma-canonical Windows field names. Requires pyarrow and evtx.

converters.name: exchange2timesketch
converters.description: Microsoft Exchange Server protocol logs (HttpProxy per front-end protocol, ECP, RPC Client Access, IMAP4/POP3) to Timesketch timeline, generic over the '#Fields:' CSV preamble.

converters.name: filterlog2timesketch
converters.description: pfSense/OPNsense filterlog firewall logs to Timesketch timeline.

converters.name: filterlog2vestigo
converters.description: pfSense/OPNsense filterlog firewall logs (plain or .gz, file or directory) to a Vestigo Parquet file for direct upload. Requires pyarrow.

converters.name: haproxy2timesketch
converters.description: HAProxy HTTP/TCP logs, connection/SSL errors and startup/reload lines (plain or .gz, file or directory) to Timesketch timeline. Auto-detects a Docker json-file, syslog, or bare envelope and measures the accept_date timezone rather than assuming it.

converters.name: haproxy2vestigo
converters.description: HAProxy HTTP/TCP logs, connection errors and startup lines (plain or .gz, file or directory) to a Vestigo Parquet file for direct upload. Auto-detects a Docker json-file, syslog, or bare envelope and measures the accept_date timezone rather than assuming it. Requires pyarrow.

converters.name: journal2timesketch
converters.description: systemd journal (via journalctl JSON export) to Timesketch timeline.

converters.name: nginx2timesketch
converters.description: nginx access/error/redirect logs to Timesketch timeline.

converters.name: nginx2vestigo
converters.description: nginx access/error/redirect logs (plain or .gz, file or directory) to a Vestigo Parquet file for direct upload. Requires pyarrow.

converters.name: pcap2timesketch
converters.description: Packet captures (pcap/pcapng) to Timesketch timeline, decoded to Ethernet/IPv4/IPv6/TCP/UDP/ICMP/ARP headers, with optional TCP reassembly of HTTP/1.x transactions (--reassemble http).

converters.name: pcap2vestigo
converters.description: Packet captures (pcap/pcapng, file or directory) to a Vestigo Parquet file for direct upload, decoded to Ethernet/IPv4/IPv6/TCP/UDP/ICMP/ARP headers, with optional TCP reassembly of HTTP/1.x transactions (--reassemble http). Requires pyarrow.

converters.name: squid2timesketch
converters.description: Squid proxy access.log (native 'logformat squid' or httpd-style common/combined, detected from the data), cache.log incl. helper output and wrapped continuation lines, and icap.log to Timesketch timeline.

converters.name: suricata2timesketch
converters.description: Suricata IDS/IPS logs (EVE JSON, fast.log, OPNsense syslog export) to Timesketch timeline.

converters.name: suricata2vestigo
converters.description: Suricata IDS/IPS logs (EVE JSON, fast.log, OPNsense syslog export; plain or .gz, file or directory) to a Vestigo Parquet file for direct upload. Requires pyarrow.

converters.name: syslog2timesketch
converters.description: Linux syslog/auth.log (RFC 3164 BSD, year-first BSD, or rsyslog ISO headers; plain text, rotated or gzip) to Timesketch timeline.

converters.name: timesketch2parquet
converters.description: Generic Timesketch-compatible CSV/JSONL (any column set, plain or .gz, file or directory) to a Vestigo Parquet file for direct upload. Column requirements follow upstream google/timesketch's own import spec. Requires pyarrow.

converters.name: w3c2timesketch
converters.description: W3C Extended Log File Format logs — IIS site logs (u_ex*.log), http.sys HTTPERR logs, and any other '#Fields:'-described W3C log — to Timesketch timeline. The field directive is honored per occurrence, so a column set that changes mid-file (an IIS restart) is parsed against the block it describes.

converters.name: w3c2vestigo
converters.description: W3C Extended Log File Format logs — IIS site logs (u_ex*.log), http.sys HTTPERR logs, and any other '#Fields:'-described W3C log (plain or .gz, file or directory searched recursively) — to a Vestigo Parquet file for direct upload. The field directive is honored per occurrence, so a column set that changes mid-file (an IIS restart) is parsed against the block it describes, in parallel runs too. Requires pyarrow.

converters.name: webhoneypot2timesketch
converters.description: DShield webhoneypot (isc-agent) HTTP request logs to Timesketch timeline, incl. reverse-proxy X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-Ip client resolution and matched signature metadata.

converters.name: zeek2timesketch
converters.description: Zeek (Bro) NSM TSV logs (conn.log, dns.log, http.log, and any other header-described log type, incl. rotated/gzip) to Timesketch timeline.
